surface_dispatch.reason: The bound operative flag is zero, so get_surface_type returns each declared SDFPerturb type unchanged. Ordinary post-mesh dispatch admits only Displacement, and its Blender modifier list admits only BlenderDisplacement. Neither opaque attribute has either type. The two SDF perturbations were instead registered in LandTiles occupancy evaluation.
surface_dispatch.not_a_zero_displacement_function_claim: The empty post-pass list does not mean the terrain is unperturbed. Mountain and snow are nontrivial occupancy SDF kernels; snow has no imported parameter arrays, which does not imply its library operation is zero.
surface_dispatch.prohibited_double_application: Do not apply mountain or snow again through SurfaceKernel(Mesh) to this frozen geometry. Doing so changes the configured pipeline and applies an additional displacement, rather than completing an omitted ordinary stage.
surface_dispatch.dict_mesh_distinction: Element.__call__ legitimately invokes SurfaceKernel(dict) inside occupancy evaluation, with fixed upward normal and Z-only offset subtracted from SDF. A genuine post-surface-displacement pass would require the separate Mesh branch with current vertex normals and XYZ offsets. No such post pass is selected here.
